desktop_reference.font_stack: Berkeley Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace

known_differences: The native Stitch screen is about 3706 CSS px high versus the 4209px observed desktop reference and invents model-badge names; it is preserved but not served directly.
The public draft uses dated server-rendered official markup and styles plus captured media to correct the native screen; original hydration scripts were removed.
Install tabs, FAQ and copy button use simple source-backed replacement interactions; mobile navigation and waitlist behavior need interaction acceptance.
Live statistics may change after the reference date.
Rendered visual comparison of the published draft against both desktop and mobile official layouts remains pending, so exact parity is unverified.
hosting_media_note: The public draft streams its existing official demonstration video from https://opencode.ai/_build/assets/opencode-min-CiEsORKQ.mp4. The captured original and SHA-256 provenance remain in source; the video is omitted from the deployment archive.
